paper_metadata.title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code
paper_metadata.abstract: We release Code Llama, a family of large language models for code based on Llama 2 providing state-of-the-art performance among open models, infilling capabilities, support for large input contexts, and zero-shot instruction following ability for programming tasks. We provide multiple flavors to cover a wide range of applications: foundation models (Code Llama), Python specializations (Code Llama - Python), and instruction-following models (Code Llama - Instruct) with 7B, 13B, 34B and 70B parameters each. All models are trained on sequences of 16k tokens and show improvements on inputs with up to 100k tokens. 7B, 13B and 70B Code Llama and Code Llama - Instruct variants support infilling based on surrounding content. Code Llama reaches state-of-the-art performance among open models on several code benchmarks, with scores of up to 67% and 65% on HumanEval and MBPP, respectively. Notably, Code Llama - Python 7B outperforms Llama 2 70B on HumanEval and MBPP, and all our models outperform every other publicly available model on MultiPL-E. We release Code Llama under a permissive license that allows for both research and commercial use.

extraction_data.innovation: Code infilling objective using causal masking with prefix-suffix-middle (PSM) and suffix-prefix-middle (SPM) formatting; Long Context Fine-Tuning (LCFT) extending sequence length to 16,384 tokens via rotary position embedding base period scaling (10,000 to 1,000,000); instruction fine-tuning for conversational code generation; Python-specialized variant trained on additional 100B tokens with 75% Python data.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Near-deduplicated publicly available code dataset, 8% natural language related to code, 7% natural language
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Instruction fine-tuning (for Instruct variant), Instruction fine-tuning, Instruction tuning / alignment for safety and coding performance
extraction_data.application: Code generation, code completion, type inference, in-code documentation, instruction following for code
extraction_data.paper_title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Proprietary instruction data, machine-generated self-instruct dataset (Llama 2 prompts for coding problems + Code Llama generated unittests/solutions), Llama 2 instruction tuning dataset, Self-instruct data generated by the model and filtered with unit tests; unnatural instructions, Code and natural language instruction data
extraction_data.supported_language: Python, C++, Java, PHP, TypeScript, Bash, English
extraction_data.hardware_description: 128 NVIDIA A100-80GB GPUs for 7B/13B; 192 NVIDIA A100-80GB GPUs for 34B
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on general text and code -> infilling fine-tuning -> long-context extension (RoPE modification) -> instruction fine-tuning (for Instruct variant)
extraction_data.benchmark_result: HumanEval 67%, MBPP 65%, MultiPL-E outperforms all other publicly available models; HumanEval pass@1: 53.0% (70B), 48.8% (34B), 36.0% (13B), 33.5% (7B); MBPP pass@1: 57.3% (70B), 53.7% (34B), 42.7% (13B), 34.8% (7B); HumanEval 33.2% (7B), 36.8% (13B); MBPP 43.3% (7B), 49.2% (13B); Test loss 0.408 (7B), 0.372 (13B); State-of-the-art among public models on standard Python completion benchmarks; 7B outperforms every other public model on multilingual benchmarks
